title: The Dark Truth About Tougen Anki #Shorts
description:
The cold light on Tougen Anki leaves the facts intact and only the comfort removed. Tougen Anki: Legend of the Cursed Blood (桃源暗鬼, Tōgen Anki) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Yura Urushibara. It has been serialized in Akita Shoten's shōnen manga magazine Weekly Shōnen Champion since June 2020.

Tougen Anki did not evolve to be understood — only to be survived. A role-playing video game adaptation by Com2uS, titled Tougen Anki: Crimson Inferno (桃源暗鬼 Crimson Inferno), was announced in March 2025 for mobile devices and PC. The manga was nominated for the 2021 Next Manga Awards in the print category.
